name: PORT OF SHANGHAI
operator: SIPG (Shanghai International Port Group) — Chinese state. World's busiest container port.
status: BRI origin. 49M TEU/year. Eastern terminus of Maritime Silk Road and Eurasian Land Bridge.

name: PORT OF SHENZHEN
operator: Shenzhen Port Group + Hutchison Ports + COSCO. Multiple terminals.
status: World's 4th busiest port. Major BRI Maritime departure point for SE Asia and Indian Ocean.

name: PORT OF GUANGZHOU (NANSHA)
operator: Guangzhou Port Group — Chinese state. COSCO and PSA terminals.
status: Pearl River Delta mega-port. 24M TEU. Key BRI Maritime node.

name: PORT OF XIAMEN
operator: Xiamen Port Holding Group — Chinese state. COSCO terminal.
status: Major Taiwan Strait port. BRI Maritime node for SE Asia routes.

name: PORT OF LIANYUNGANG
operator: Lianyungang Port Group — Chinese state. Kazakhstan has terminal stake.
status: Eastern terminus of New Eurasian Land Bridge. Direct rail to Kazakhstan/Europe.

name: PORT OF SINGAPORE
operator: PSA International (Singapore state) + Jurong Port. World's 2nd busiest container port.
status: Malacca Strait chokepoint hub. Every BRI Maritime shipment passes through. 39M TEU.

name: PORT KLANG
operator: Westports (Malaysian private) + Northport (MMC Group). China Merchants has stake.
status: Malaysia's busiest port. Malacca Strait. China Merchants expanding presence.

name: LAEM CHABANG PORT
operator: Port Authority of Thailand. Hutchison Ports terminal. Phase 3 under construction.
status: Thailand's largest port. China-Indochina corridor southern node. Connected to planned Bangkok HSR.

name: HAI PHONG PORT
operator: Vinalines (Vietnam state) + SITC (HK). New Lach Huyen deep-water terminal (Japanese-funded).
status: Vietnam's main northern port. BRI alternative route via Vietnam. Japan competing with China here.

name: SIHANOUKVILLE PORT
operator: Sihanoukville Autonomous Port (Cambodia state). Massive Chinese SEZ adjacent.
status: China's Cambodia anchor. Chinese-funded expansion. BRI showcase. Rumored dual-use military potential.

name: PORT OF COLOMBO
operator: SLPA (Sri Lanka state) + CICT terminal (China Merchants 85%) + SAGT (APM Terminals/Maersk).
status: Indian Ocean's busiest transshipment hub. China Merchants controls main terminal. India + Japan building rival Colombo West terminal.

name: CHITTAGONG PORT
operator: Chittagong Port Authority (Bangladesh state). China building nearby Payra deep-water port.
status: Bangladesh's main port. 90% of trade. China investing in nearby Payra and Matarbari ports.

name: PORT OF KARACHI
operator: KPT (Pakistan state). DP World and Hutchison operate terminals. China expanding at nearby Port Qasim.
status: Pakistan's largest port. CPEC southern node. Handles 60% of Pakistan's cargo. China at adjacent Port Qasim.

name: CHABAHAR PORT
operator: India Ports Global (India state consortium). Iran's PMOI manages. India invested $500M+.
status: India's Iran gateway — bypasses Pakistan/Gwadar. INSTC key node. Only Indian-operated foreign port. US sanctions exemption.

name: BANDAR ABBAS PORT
operator: PMO — Ports & Maritime Organization of Iran (Iranian state). Shahid Rajaee terminal.
status: Iran's busiest port. Hormuz Strait. INSTC maritime-rail junction. Handles 85% of Iran's container traffic.

name: PORT OF AKTAU
operator: Kazakhstan Temir Zholy (state railway). Caspian ferry terminal. Capacity being doubled.
status: Middle Corridor Caspian crossing point. Kazakhstan → Azerbaijan. Cargo up 200%+ since 2022.

name: PORT OF BAKU / ALAT
operator: Baku International Sea Trade Port (Azerbaijan state). New Alat terminal opened 2018.
status: Middle Corridor Caspian western terminus. INSTC junction. $400M new port at Alat. Capacity 25M tons.

name: PORT OF POTI
operator: APM Terminals (Maersk/Denmark) — majority. Previously DP World bid blocked.
status: Georgia's Black Sea port. Middle Corridor rail-to-sea node. EU-funded expansion.

name: PORT OF BATUMI
operator: Batumi Oil Terminal (KazMunayGas-Kazakhstan). Batumi Sea Port (private).
status: Georgia's second Black Sea port. Oil terminal. Middle Corridor petroleum route.

name: PORT OF MERSIN
operator: Mersin International Port (PSA Singapore + Akfen). Turkey's largest Mediterranean port.
status: Middle Corridor Mediterranean exit. Iraq Development Road alternative endpoint. Turkey's busiest med port.

name: PORT OF ISKENDERUN
operator: TCDD (Turkish State Railways) + Limak. Near Iraq Dev Road northern terminus.
status: Iraq Development Road Mediterranean endpoint. Closest Turkish port to Iraq/Syria border.

name: PORT SAID
operator: Suez Canal Authority (Egypt state). East Port Said (APM Terminals + COSCO terminal).
status: Suez Canal northern entrance. Every maritime corridor passes here. COSCO + APM both present.

name: JEDDAH ISLAMIC PORT
operator: Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani). DP World + Hutchison operate terminals.
status: Red Sea hub. Saudi Arabia's busiest commercial port. Handles Hajj logistics + Red Sea trade.

name: PORT OF ADEN
operator: Aden Container Terminal (DP World concession — suspended). Largely non-functional due to civil war.
status: Bab al-Mandab adjacent. Was major transshipment hub pre-war. Houthi conflict paralyzed operations.

name: PORT OF MASSAWA
operator: Eritrean government. UAE had military base nearby (vacated 2021).
status: Red Sea western shore. Limited commercial traffic. Strategic for Red Sea control.

name: PORT OF MOMBASA
operator: Kenya Ports Authority (state). China Road and Bridge Corporation built new Kipevu terminal.
status: East Africa's largest port. SGR railway terminus (Chinese-built). Gateway to Uganda/DRC.

name: PORT OF DAR ES SALAAM
operator: Tanzania Ports Authority (state). DP World signed 30-year concession 2023. China built SGR to Morogoro.
status: Tanzania's main port. DP World + Chinese SGR both present. Gateway to DRC/Zambia copper belt.
tag: CONTESTED — DP WORLD vs CHINA SGR

name: PORT OF LAMU (LAPSSET)
operator: Kenya Ports Authority. First berth opened 2021. LAPSSET mega-project (Kenya/Ethiopia/S.Sudan).
status: New deep-water port. LAPSSET corridor to Ethiopia/South Sudan. Slow progress. Potential IMEC/Africa link.

name: PORT OF LOBITO
operator: Angola state. US-backed Lobito Atlantic Railway concession (Trafigura consortium).
status: US/EU counter-BRI in Africa. Rail link to DRC/Zambia copper belt. $1B+ US/EU investment. Biden flagship.

name: PORT OF WALVIS BAY
operator: Namport (Namibia state). China funded $300M expansion (opened 2019). Connected to Botswana/Zambia.
status: Southern Africa's deepwater port. Chinese-funded expansion. Alternative to South African ports.

name: PORT OF TEMA
operator: Ghana Ports Authority + Meridian Port Services (Bolloré/APM Terminals). New $1.5B terminal.
status: West Africa's most modern port. French/Danish operated. Gateway to landlocked Sahel countries.

name: APAPA / TINCAN PORT (LAGOS)
operator: Nigerian Ports Authority. APM Terminals + Bolloré + China Harbour Engineering.
status: West Africa's busiest port. Nigeria handles 70% of West African trade. China building Lekki Deep Sea Port nearby.

name: TANGER MED
operator: TMSA (Morocco state). APM Terminals + Eurogate + Marsa Maroc terminals. Africa's largest port.
status: Gibraltar Strait. Africa's #1 container port. 9M+ TEU. Mediterranean transshipment mega-hub.

name: PORT OF ALGECIRAS
operator: APM Terminals (Maersk). Spain's busiest container port. Gibraltar Strait.
status: Mediterranean western gateway. APM/Maersk hub. Opposite Tanger Med across Gibraltar.

name: PORT OF MARSEILLE-FOS
operator: Grand Port Maritime de Marseille (French state). CMA CGM (France) home port.
status: Proposed IMEC European endpoint (alternative to Piraeus). France's largest port. CMA CGM's base.

name: PORT OF GENOA
operator: Genoa Port Authority (Italian state). COSCO had BRI MOU (Italy withdrew 2023). MSC headquarters nearby.
status: Italy's busiest port. Italy left BRI in 2023. Now aligned with IMEC/EU corridor strategy.

name: PORT OF ROTTERDAM
operator: Port of Rotterdam Authority (Dutch state + municipality). COSCO terminal present.
status: Europe's largest port. 14M TEU. BRI Maritime + Eurasian Land Bridge western terminus. COSCO has terminal.

name: PORT OF HAMBURG
operator: HHLA (Hamburg state). COSCO acquired 24.9% stake in HHLA 2023 — controversial deal.
status: Germany's largest port. COSCO's contested minority stake. China-Europe rail terminus.

name: DUISBURG INLAND PORT
operator: Duisburger Hafen AG (German state NRW). World's largest inland port.
status: China-Europe rail freight terminus. 'Duisburg Gateway' terminal. 60+ trains/week from China.

name: PORT OF GDANSK
operator: Port of Gdansk Authority (Polish state). DCT Gdansk (PSA Singapore). Poland's largest port.
status: Baltic gateway. Eurasian Land Bridge transit point via Belarus/Poland rail. Growing as EU redistribution hub.

name: PORT OF ST. PETERSBURG
operator: Global Ports (Russian private) + state terminals. Russia's largest container port.
status: INSTC northern terminus. Russia's Baltic gateway. Western shipping largely withdrawn post-sanctions.

name: PORT OF MURMANSK
operator: Murmansk Commercial Seaport (Russian state). Arctic LNG transshipment hub.
status: Northern Sea Route western terminus. Arctic LNG hub. Ice-free year-round. Russia expanding capacity.

name: PORT OF VLADIVOSTOK
operator: FESCO Group (Russian). Russia's Pacific gateway.
status: Russia's main Pacific port. Northern Sea Route eastern hub. China transit corridor to avoid Malacca.

name: GRAND FAW PORT
operator: Iraq General Company for Ports (state). Daewoo (S.Korea) + Italian consortium building.
status: Under construction. Iraq Development Road southern terminus. $2.6B Phase 1. Will be Iraq's deepwater port.

name: PORT OF AQABA
operator: Aqaba Development Corporation (Jordan state) + APM Terminals.
status: IMEC overland route junction. Jordan's only port. Red Sea access. Rail planned to Saudi/Israel.

name: PORT OF MAPUTO
operator: DP World (UAE) — 30-year concession since 2023. Connected to South Africa + Eswatini rail.
status: DP World's southern Africa base. Alternative to Durban. Corridor to South Africa + Zimbabwe.

name: PORT OF BUSHEHR
operator: Iran Ports & Maritime Organization (state). Oil export terminal.
status: Secondary Iranian Gulf port. Oil exports. INSTC feeder. Near Bushehr nuclear facility.

name: MANZANILLO INTERNATIONAL TERMINAL (COLÓN)
operator: SSA Marine (US-Carrix). Colón Container Terminal by Evergreen/Hutchison. Colón Free Zone.
status: Atlantic-side Panama Canal port. Colón Free Zone — world's 2nd largest. Complements Pacific-side Balboa.

name: PORT OF LEKKI (LAGOS)
operator: China Harbour Engineering + Tolaram + Lagos State. Opened 2023.
status: Chinese-built deep-sea port. West Africa's newest. Complements congested Apapa/Tincan.

name: PORT OF MELBOURNE
operator: Lonsdale Consortium (QIC, Future Fund, GIP). Privatized 2016 for $7.7B. Australia's busiest container port.
status: Australia's #1 container port. AUKUS-aligned. China was top trade partner — now decoupling.

name: PORT OF SYDNEY (BOTANY)
operator: NSW Ports (IFM Investors consortium). Hutchison operates one terminal.
status: Australia's 2nd busiest container port. Hutchison (HK) terminal presence noted by security hawks.

name: PORT OF DARWIN
operator: Landbridge Group (Chinese private) — 99-year lease since 2015. US Marines rotate through Darwin.
status: China's 99-year lease next to US Marine base. Australia reviewing under critical infrastructure laws. AUKUS flashpoint.

name: PORT HEDLAND
operator: Pilbara Ports Authority (WA state). BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue ship iron ore.
status: World's largest bulk export port. 600M+ tons/year. Iron ore to China — Australia's #1 export commodity.
tag: WORLD'S LARGEST BULK PORT — IRON ORE TO CHINA

name: PORT OF FREMANTLE
operator: Fremantle Ports (WA state). Indian Ocean gateway. HMAS Stirling naval base nearby.
status: Australia's Indian Ocean gateway. Closest major port to IMEC/BRI maritime lanes. Naval base adjacent.

name: SHAHID RAJAEE PORT (BANDAR IMAM KHOMEINI)
operator: Iran PMO (state). Iran's largest commercial port on Persian Gulf. Petrochemical hub.
status: Iran's Persian Gulf industrial port. Oil/petrochemical exports. INSTC feeder to rail network.

name: PORT OF ASSALUYEH (SOUTH PARS)
operator: NIOC/Pars Oil & Gas (Iranian state). South Pars gas field — world's largest.
status: Iran's gas export hub. South Pars/North Dome field. Shared with Qatar. Sanctions limit exports.

name: PORT OF KHORRAMSHAHR
operator: Iran PMO (state). Iraq border river port on Shatt al-Arab.
status: Iran-Iraq border port. Strategic for Iran-Iraq trade. Devastated in Iran-Iraq War, rebuilt.

name: PORT OF LOS ANGELES / LONG BEACH
operator: City of LA / Long Beach (US municipal). COSCO, Evergreen, APM, SSA terminals. USA's busiest port complex.
status: Western Hemisphere's busiest port. 20M+ TEU combined. Largest US gateway for China trade. COSCO terminal present.

name: PORT OF NEW YORK / NEW JERSEY
operator: Port Authority of NY & NJ (US state). APM, Maersk, MSC terminals. East Coast's busiest.
status: US East Coast's #1 port. Surpassed LA/LB in 2023. Atlantic trade gateway. NATO logistics hub.

name: PORT OF HOUSTON
operator: Port Houston Authority (US state). Largest US petrochemical port. Gulf of Mexico.
status: US energy export hub. LNG, oil, petrochemicals. Gulf Coast strategic anchor.

name: PORT OF MIAMI
operator: Miami-Dade County (US municipal). Largest US cruise port. Caribbean/Latin America gateway.
status: Gateway to Caribbean and Latin America. Cruise capital. Strategic for Western Hemisphere trade.

name: PORT OF SAVANNAH
operator: Georgia Ports Authority (US state). Fastest-growing US port. Inland rail hub.
status: Fastest-growing major US port. Massive inland intermodal network. Competing with NY/NJ.

name: PORT OF SANTOS
operator: Santos Port Authority (Brazilian state). China Merchants acquired Brasil Terminal Portuário. COSCO calls.
status: Latin America's busiest port. China is Brazil's #1 trade partner. Soy, iron ore, beef to China.

name: PORT OF BUENOS AIRES
operator: AGP (Argentine state). TRP terminal (Hutchison). China building $1.2B Río de la Plata deep-water extension.
status: Argentina's main port. Hutchison terminal. China funding deep-water port expansion. Argentina joined BRI 2022.

name: PORT OF VALPARAÍSO
operator: TPS Valparaíso (OHL/ULTRAMAR). China Merchants investing in nearby San Antonio expansion.
status: Chile's main container port. China is Chile's #1 trade partner. Copper exports. San Antonio mega-port planned.

name: PORT OF MANZANILLO
operator: API Manzanillo (Mexican state). Hutchison terminal. SSA Mexico. Mexico's busiest port.
status: Mexico's #1 container port. Pacific gateway. China-Mexico trade booming via nearshoring trend.

name: PORT OF LÁZARO CÁRDENAS
operator: API Lázaro Cárdenas (Mexican state). APM Terminals + Hutchison. Deep-water Pacific port.
status: Mexico's deepest Pacific port. Growing as US-China decoupling reroutes trade through Mexico.

name: PORT OF CARTAGENA
operator: SPRC + Contecar (Colombian private groups). Caribbean transshipment hub.
status: Caribbean's busiest transshipment port. Colombia's main gateway. Strategic Caribbean position.

name: PORT OF CALLAO
operator: DP World (UAE) operates Muelle Sur. APM Terminals operates Muelle Norte. Peru's #1 port.
status: Peru's main port. DP World + APM Terminals. Chancay (COSCO) diverting traffic. 2.5M TEU.

name: PORT OF MARIEL
operator: PSA International (Singapore) operates. Brazilian-funded ($900M). China deepening ties.
status: Cuba's modern container port. China, Russia, Venezuela axis. 90 miles from US. Potential intelligence concern.

name: PORT OF HAVANA
operator: Cuban state. Limited commercial traffic due to US embargo. Russia/China naval visits.
status: Historic port. Russian warships docked 2024. China signals expanding presence. US embargo limits trade.

name: PORT OF KINGSTON
operator: Kingston Freeport Terminal (CMA CGM). China Harbour Engineering built new causeway/infrastructure.
status: Caribbean's largest transshipment port. CMA CGM operated. Chinese infrastructure investment growing.

name: PORT OF COLOMBO (WEST TERMINAL)
operator: Adani Ports (India) + John Keells (Sri Lanka) — joint development. India/Japan counter to Chinese CICT terminal.
status: India + Japan countering China's Colombo terminal dominance. Under construction. Strategic balancing act.

name: PORT OF BUSAN
operator: Busan Port Authority (Korean state). Hutchison + DP World + PSA terminals. World's 6th busiest.
status: World's #6 container port. 22M TEU. Northeast Asia transshipment mega-hub. US ally.

name: PORT OF TOKYO / YOKOHAMA
operator: Tokyo Port Authority + Yokohama Port Corp (Japanese state/municipal). NYK, MOL, K-Line home base.
status: Japan's main port complex. Key US Pacific ally. Quad member. BRI maritime transit point.

name: PORT OF KOBE / OSAKA
operator: Kobe-Osaka International Port Corp (Japanese state). Western Japan gateway.
status: Japan's western gateway. Rebuilt after 1995 earthquake. Industrial heartland port.

name: PORT OF KAOHSIUNG
operator: TIPC (Taiwan state). Evergreen, Yang Ming, Wan Hai home port. World's 15th busiest.
status: Taiwan's largest port. Evergreen Marine HQ. Taiwan Strait flashpoint. Critical semiconductor supply chain node.

name: PORT OF KYAUKPHYU
operator: CITIC Group (China state) — 70% stake in deep-sea port project. Myanmar military junta partner.
status: China's Malacca bypass. Oil/gas pipeline terminus. Deep-sea port under development. Strategic Indian Ocean access.

name: PORT MORESBY
operator: PNG Ports Corporation (state). Australia + US increasing presence. China infrastructure deals expanding.
status: Pacific Islands gateway. US/Australia vs China competition. Military access agreements with Australia.

name: SUVA PORT
operator: Fiji Ports Corporation (state). China funded port upgrades. Australia/NZ counter-investing.
status: South Pacific hub. China expanding influence. Australia's 'Pacific Step-Up' competing. Strategic Pacific position.

name: PORT SUDAN
operator: Sea Ports Corporation (Sudan state). Russia sought naval base (2020 deal). Civil war complicates.
status: Red Sea port. Russia's planned naval base. Sudan civil war (2023-) devastated operations. Strategic but unstable.
tag: RED SEA — RUSSIA NAVAL BASE PLANNED

name: PORT LOUIS
operator: Mauritius Ports Authority (state). DP World + India investing. Indian Ocean relay point.
status: Indian Ocean relay hub. India's 'Necklace of Diamonds' counter to China's 'String of Pearls'. DP World terminal.

name: PORT OF ISTANBUL (AMBARLI)
operator: Multiple: DP World, Yilport, Kumport (COSCO 26% stake). Turkey's busiest port complex.
status: Bosporus gateway. Turkey's busiest container port. COSCO has minority stake in Kumport. Middle Corridor terminus.

name: PORT OF CONSTANTA
operator: National Company Maritime Ports Administration (Romanian state). DP World terminal. EU/NATO.
status: Black Sea's largest port. EU grain export corridor. NATO logistics hub. Alternative to Turkish straits bottleneck.

name: PORT OF NOVOROSSIYSK
operator: NCSP Group (Russian state). Russia's largest Black Sea port. Oil export terminal.
status: Russia's main Black Sea port. Oil exports. CPC pipeline terminus (Kazakhstan oil). Sanctions-hit.

name: PORT OF DJIBOUTI (DORALEH CONTAINER)
operator: DP World concession terminated 2018. China Merchants 23.5% stake. Djibouti state reclaimed control.
status: Djibouti expelled DP World. China expanding. US, Japan, France, Italy all have military bases within 10km radius.

name: DIEGO GARCIA
operator: US/UK military. US Naval Support Facility. B-52 bomber base. No commercial port.
status: US military's Indian Ocean anchor. Strategic bomber + surveillance base. UK sovereignty disputed with Mauritius.

name: PORT OF DUQM (CHINA-OMAN SEZ)
operator: Wanfang (China) operates $10.7B industrial zone inside Duqm SEZ. Separate from main Duqm port.
status: China's industrial zone embedded inside Oman's strategic port. Manufacturing + logistics hub being built.
tag: CHINA SEZ — INSIDE OMAN'S STRATEGIC PORT
